name: Professor Putricide
guide_text: Do not hero power on tavern 2 because tavern 2 creations are terrible. Instead, hero power on tavern 3+. Coin + reborn creation is the strongest on tavern 3 or 4, and tavern 4+ unlocks venomous and poisonous undeads that you can reborn.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 5-7 gold because it's a value generating creation. Remember to reborn it in the midgame to generate even more creations. Save the reborn/poisonous ones for your final comp.
